## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of the problem. e.g. "I find it frustrating when..."

Other approaches you thought about.

## Phase fit

Which phase do you think this belongs in? (See `spec-kit-input/plan.md`)

- [ ] v1 (P1–P9)
- [ ] v2 (P10–P15)
- [ ] v3 (P16+)
- [ ] Not sure

Screenshots, mockups, or related links.
